title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Nasdaq crashes 2% as AI, oil risks drive flight to bonds - The Economic Times
text: US Market | Dow Jones Live Updates: Wall Street trades lower as renewed concerns over AI spending weigh on tech stocks, with Nasdaq falling 1.46%. Tesla and Meta decline after their updates fail to ease investor worries, while oil prices rebound on supply fears. Defensive sectors gain as investors turn cautious.
